window: OpenRouter public monthly usage and current public model signals

methodology.weight_selection: Use task_weights when a model has sources.flexprice_tasks; otherwise use weights.
methodology.index_description: Models with Flexprice task results: 30% capability + 25% preference + 20% adoption + 25% Flexprice tasks. Models without task results: 40% capability + 35% preference + 25% adoption.
methodology.normalization: Capability uses the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index when published, otherwise a catalog-feature estimate calibrated against benchmarked models with a 10-point text capability floor. Preference combines Arena ratings (70%) and developer request activity (30%) where Arena is available; otherwise it uses request activity. Adoption is log-scaled OpenRouter token volume. Models with no published usage receive zero for request activity and adoption.
methodology.task_normalization: The local Flexprice task composite is 0.35 × accuracy + 0.30 × extraction + 0.20 × convention + 0.15 × max(0, 100 − hallucination) − 0.20 × consistency, clamped to 0–100 and rounded to one decimal. With two or more matched models, composites are min-max normalized to 0–100; if all composites are equal, they normalize to 100. A single matched model keeps its composite score. The Index uses this normalized task score.
methodology.caveat: Flexprice Index combines public signals with local task results where available. It is not a standalone contract-extraction accuracy score and does not imply that every model has Flexprice task results.
